ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_Entry_Dispute', ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, 'Incorrect BSB/ Account Number'), OR( ISBLANK(Customer_Description__c), ISPICKVAL(Is_this_a_Business_Customer__c,''), ISBLANK(Intended_Account_BSB__c), ISBLANK(Intended_Account_Name__c), ISBLANK(Intended_Account_Number__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required: Customer Description, Is this a Business Customer, Intended Account BSB, Intended Account Name, Intended Account Number.
